health_contract.aggregate_rule: READY only when identity, authorization and broker are each healthy and a synthetic end-to-end probe passes; every unknown/unhealthy state is DENY

identity_provider.probe: internal ZITADEL readiness plus synthetic identity issuance/readback
identity_provider.success: ready=true and synthetic identity operation PASS

authorization_policy.probe: internal OPA health plus known ALLOW and known DENY policy checks
authorization_policy.success: health PASS and both expected decisions match

credential_broker.probe: internal OpenBao health/unsealed state plus exact-scope synthetic read
credential_broker.success: health=active and exact-scope synthetic read PASS

health_contract.outage_rule: No component failure may trigger an alternate engine to seek ALLOW. The shadow result is discarded and the production incumbent path remains canonical.

operator_inspection: query OfficeV2 LAB Lease state from Windows Task Scheduler
inspect systemd unit state inside OfficeV2-Lab
inspect sanitized health receipt and component container status
never infer healthy from process existence alone
service_autostart_plan.activation_rule: Do not install or enable the target before a separate explicit SHADOW promotion receipt.

key_material_handling.encryption: Windows DPAPI CurrentUser under the same Chris user context as OfficeV2 LAB Lease
key_material_handling.acl_policy: inheritance removed; current user and SYSTEM only
key_material_handling.plaintext_runtime_policy: tmpfs/runtime-only, mode 0700 directory and 0600 files, written via stdin not CLI args, removed on stop
not_persisted: OpenBao bootstrap root token after scoped bootstrap is complete

rollback_action: discard candidate shadow decisions and credential-resolution results
do not migrate, rewrite or rebind production state

promotion_boundary: A runtime-readiness PASS is still pre-SHADOW. It never installs/enables services and never advances CURRENT.json; an explicit project-state SHADOW promotion receipt remains mandatory.
